changelog:
Ground-up voice architecture rebuild — Voice Pro+ with three major upgrades. Pipeline now modular across three independent stages: Capture, Wake Word, and Voiceprint + Audio Events running in parallel. Adding capabilities no longer slows existing ones. Tested across full Android 5 to 16 device range.

**Voice Config Fully Restructured** — all voice settings unified under Settings → Voice Config with clear sub-entries: Wake Word, Voiceprint, Audio Events, Microphone. Each has plain descriptions, no manual needed.

**Custom Wake Words** — import trained models via ZIP or JSON. Two wake words independently tuned with per-word sensitivity and wake sounds. Different family members, different languages, different rooms — each gets its own wake word.

**Voiceprint Recognition Rebuilt** — Manual mode enrolls speakers with guided recording, gates wake to recognized voices only. Automatic mode needs zero setup, learns household voices over time, reports to HA sensor for automations. Fully on-device, no cloud. Switch modes anytime with confirmation.

**Audio Event Detection** — YAMNet classifier on dedicated thread, independent from wake/voiceprint. Detects alarm, doorbell, baby cry, cough, speech. Three sensitivity levels, configurable alert duration, HA sensor for notifications. Assistive reference, not safety system.

Fixes: ADB update checker commands, Interaction renamed to Extensions, home screen button visuals across sizes and dark/light modes, video recording bidirectional sync, camera video black screen on legacy devices #87 @treypop, adaptive scaling, settings descriptions unified across languages.
